asr_text: Researchers mapped over 8,900 moon cliffs and estimated that its radius shrank 42 to 46 meters in a later period. This is not all its shrinking since the moon formed. A thick rock layer with many gaps may have slowed cooling and help explain why models predict much more shrinking.
